class TieredAccountRateThrottle(BaseThrottle):

class LegalAgreementDiffView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, agreement_id):
        from_version_id = request.query_params.get('from_version')
        to_version_id = request.query_params.get('to_version')

        # Fetches versions directly by primary key without validating object ownership
        try:
            v_from = Version.objects.get(pk=from_version_id)
            v_to = Version.objects.get(pk=to_version_id)
        except Version.DoesNotExist:
            return Response({'error': 'Version not found'}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        text_from = v_from.field_dict.get('terms_content', '').splitlines(keepends=True)
        text_to = v_to.field_dict.get('terms_content', '').splitlines(keepends=True)
        diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(text_from, text_to, fromfile='baseline', tofile='current'))
        return Response({'diff': diff})

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.core.signing import TimestampSigner, BadSignature, SignatureExpired
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import status

User = get_user_model()

class CustomPasswordResetConfirmView(APIView):
    def post(self, request):
        token = request.data.get('token')
        new_password = request.data.get('new_password')

        signer = TimestampSigner(salt='pwd-reset-confirm')
        try:
            user_id = signer.unsign(token, max_age=86400)
        except (BadSignature, SignatureExpired):
            return Response({'error': 'Token invalid or expired'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        # Directly updates user password without checking if the token was already consumed
        # or if user's password was changed since token issuance
        user = User.objects.get(pk=user_id)
        user.set_password(new_password)
        user.save()
        return Response({'status': 'Password reset successful'})

class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present?

    # CanCanCan bug: block condition cannot be translated to SQL by accessible_by.
    # When Document.accessible_by(current_ability) is executed in controllers,
    # the block is ignored and ALL records are returned without WHERE filtering!
    can :read, Document do |doc|
      doc.organization_id == user.organization_id
    end
  end
end

class DocumentsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    @documents = Document.accessible_by(current_ability)
    render json: @documents
  end
end
